facts.statement: On Amazon, page-one listings for corrugated/cardboard corner and edge protectors for shipping span roughly $15-$30+ across pack sizes and board thicknesses, with plastic and foam variants also present in the same search results
A roughly 40-count pack of adjustable cardboard corner protectors was found priced in the $12.49-$15.09 range, inside the brief's target price band

IDL Packaging is a recurring leading brand for cardboard edge/corner protectors on Amazon, selling the same basic V-board design across multiple board thicknesses (0.120in, 0.160in, 0.225in) and pack counts from about 12 units to a 2,800-unit full pallet

Amazon maintains a dedicated Best Sellers category for Packaging Edge Protectors under Industrial & Scientific, confirming corner/edge protectors are an established, separately-ranked Amazon subcategory

Multiple distinct competitor SKUs exist in this niche beyond IDL, including a bulk kraft/bobbin-paper edge protector (ASABIB, 100pcs), a light-duty 0.120-gauge edge protector (ESK Packaging, 50/pack), and a compact 100-pack corner protector sized for smaller boxes rather than pallets
Adjustable cardboard corner protectors for picture frames (e.g. a 120-pack) form a distinct, adjacent sub-market from shipping/moving box corner protectors, targeting art/frame shippers specifically

Independent review-blog content covering corner protectors for shipping exists and was refreshed for 2026, indicating active SEO/affiliate competition around the search term, though full article text could not be retrieved this session (site blocked by network egress)

Amazon's 2026 FBA fee update raised small-standard-size fulfillment fees versus 2025 - about $0.12/unit for items priced under $10 and about $0.25/unit for items priced $10-$50 - and a cited 2oz small-standard item's fee was $2.43 (under-$10 band) vs $3.32 ($10-$50 band); a new 3.5% fuel-and-logistics surcharge applies to all FBA fulfillment fees starting April 17, 2026

Amazon referral fees vary 8%-45% by category; most categories, including the general merchandise categories packaging/shipping supplies would fall under, charge the standard 15% rate, unchanged for 2026 vs 2025
HTS subheading 4819.10.0040 (cartons, boxes and cases of corrugated paper or paperboard) carries a Most-Favored-Nation base duty rate of Free (0%)

China-origin goods classified under HTS heading 4819 are subject to an additional Section 301 tariff of 25%, plus a further tariff of roughly 10% cited as effective February 24, 2026, on top of the Free MFN base rate; exact stacking treatment for this specific product was not independently confirmed

2026 China-to-US LCL ocean freight: base ocean-freight component commonly cited at $35-$80/CBM on major lanes (Shanghai to US West Coast base around $45-$55/CBM in early 2026), while all-in landed LCL cost including origin/destination handling and surcharges is commonly cited at $100-$150/CBM

price_ladder.anchor_note: The visual anchor on row one is bulk industrial V-board/L-angle packs (40-100 count) priced $12-16; a small foldable 8+4-piece set like the brief's product must land near this $12-17 anchor to pass gate.price_vs_anchor. Heavy-duty (0.225in) and pallet-count packs push the top of page one to ~$30, but that is a different buyer (pallet/freight) than the brief's shipper/mover.

variant_chosen.description: Bulk industrial V-board/L-shaped cardboard edge protector sold in 40-100 count packs at multiple board thicknesses (0.120in/0.160in/0.225in) - e.g. the IDL Packaging line
variant_chosen.why: This is the recurring, multi-SKU, multi-thickness product line that appears repeatedly across search results and has its own dedicated Amazon Best Sellers subcategory (Packaging Edge Protectors); it is the closest thing to a category leader observable without ASIN-level review data. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: ASIN-level review counts/rank could not be fetched this session (see gaps), so this is an inferred rather than confirmed 'most successful variant'; it is also a materially different form factor (continuous edge strips) than the brief's small foldable 8-corner+4-edge set, which is closer to the smaller 100-pack compact SKU (F5).

complaint_clusters.pattern: Buyer picks a thickness/duty grade that turns out too thin for the actual box weight, so corners still crush in transit despite using the protector
complaint_clusters.root_cause_hypothesis: Inferred (not directly mined) from the fact that the category is segmented into at least three duty tiers (light/regular/heavy, 0.120in-0.225in) sold under near-identical titles - sellers only need that many tiers if mismatched-thickness-to-load is a frequent real-world failure, which is exactly the ECT-grade-mismatch risk the brief itself flags

complaint_clusters.pattern: Protector doesn't fit the buyer's actual box corner/edge dimension or is fiddly to fold and hold in place during packing
complaint_clusters.root_cause_hypothesis: Inferred from the sheer number of length/width/thickness SKU combinations sold under one brand name (IDL alone spans several lengths and three thicknesses) - a physical-fit product with this many near-duplicate variants online typically reflects frequent buyer confusion over which size to order

praise_clusters.pattern: Protector visibly does its job - box/pallet corners arrive intact and the board itself feels sturdy for the price, especially in the heavier-duty tiers
Reusable and fully recyclable, which repeat shippers/movers value for bulk, repeat ordering

referral_rate.assumption: Packaging/shipping-supplies items on Amazon fall under Industrial & Scientific or Office Products; both charge the standard 15% referral rate per 2026 fee aggregation. Range reflects category-mapping uncertainty since exact category placement for this listing type was not page-confirmed.

fba_fee_usd.assumption: 2026 update raised small-standard fulfillment fees ~$0.12/unit (<$10 band) to ~$0.25/unit ($10-$50 band) vs 2025, plus a new 3.5% fuel/logistics surcharge from Apr 17 2026. Base triangulated from a cited 2oz small-standard fee of $3.32 ($10-$50 band, matching this product's ~$13.99 ASP) scaled for the heavier 8oz tier and the surcharge; the exact 8oz-tier table row was not directly located this session (search budget exhausted).

storage_per_cuft_month_usd.assumption: STALE - search budget was exhausted before this rate could be fetched this session. Range is a placeholder spanning commonly-discussed non-peak/peak Amazon US storage bands and must be re-verified against the live 2026 FBA storage fee table before use.

duty_rate.assumption: HTS 4819.10 (corrugated paperboard cartons/boxes) carries a Free MFN base duty rate per 2026 tariff-lookup sources; genuinely zero so low=base=high. Classification assumed - the product mixes corrugated board with HDPE plastic reinforcement caps, so the true heading was not confirmed with a customs ruling (see gaps).

sea_freight_usd_per_cbm.assumption: 2026 China-to-US LCL: base ocean-freight component commonly cited at $35-$80/CBM on major lanes (Shanghai-US West Coast base ~$45-55/CBM early 2026); all-in landed LCL cost including origin/destination handling and surcharges commonly cited at $100-150/CBM. Range spans base-only low end to all-in high end since this shipment's exact quote type wasn't specified.

additional_tariff_rate.assumption: China-origin goods under HTS 4819 carry a 25% Section 301 tariff per 2026 sources, plus a newer ~10% tariff cited as effective Feb 24 2026 (stacking treatment not independently confirmed); high end allows for further reciprocal-tariff exposure not fully mapped this session.

Amazon FBA small-standard fulfillment fees rose again in the January 15, 2026 update (~$0.12-$0.25/unit) and a new 3.5% fuel/logistics surcharge began April 17, 2026 - both compress margin on low-ASP, light-weight items like this one
